title: On founders and mornings
text: Every founder I know who made it wakes up at 5am. Meanwhile the ones who sleep in are still stuck. The science on this is settled.

result.summary: The text presents a weak argument relying on hasty generalization, survivorship bias, and an appeal to authority.

flaws.quote: Every founder I know who made it wakes up at 5am.
flaws.explanation: The author generalizes from a personal sample of founders to all founders without sufficient evidence.

flaws.quote: Meanwhile the ones who sleep in are still stuck.
flaws.explanation: The author only considers visible failures (those who sleep in and are stuck) while ignoring successful people who sleep in, skewing the comparison.

flaws.quote: The science on this is settled.
flaws.explanation: The claim is backed by a vague reference to 'the science' rather than presenting actual evidence or reasoning.
